summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K submitting its Sustainability Report 2025, a routine ESG disclosure covering the period January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025. The filing contains no transaction, no acquisition or divestiture terms, no activist campaign, no tender offer, and no capital return. It is a standard foreign private issuer report on sustainability activities, prepared under GRI standards, with no special-situation event. The filing is purely informational with no deal mechanics, advisor recommendations, or regulatory clocks.
